28593-when-dreams-come-true.title: When Dreams Come True
28593-when-dreams-come-true.creator: Unknown
28593-when-dreams-come-true.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. most persons this little known land of the great Southwest is regarded as the one which God forgot. But to those who are familiar with its vast expanse of plain and horizon, its rugged sierras, its wild desolate _mesas_ and solitary peaks of half-decayed mountains--its tawny stretches of desert marked with the occasional skeletons of animal and human remains--its golden wealth of sunshine and opalescent skies, and have felt the brooding death-like silence which seems to hold as in a spell all things living

42301-poems.title: Poems
42301-poems.creator: Alexander Smith.
42301-poems.description: A book by Alexander Smith.. As Hero gave her trembling sighs to find   Delicious death on wet Leander's lip. Bare, bald, and tawdry, as a fingered moth,   Is my poor life, but with one smile thou canst   Clothe me with kingdoms. Wilt bid me die for thee? As well may some wild maiden waste her love   Upon the calm front of a marble Jove.

76247-how-joy-was-found.title: _A Fantasy_
76247-how-joy-was-found.creator: Isobel W. Hutchison
76247-how-joy-was-found.description: A book by Isobel W. Hutchison. e person ever imagined, is seen vaguely as if through a radiant light. He is seated alone on the grass watching the flowers in the midst of great beauty. Far off across the sea the outline of the Hebrides is faintly seen, and presently a brown-sailed fishing-boat appears on the edge of the horizon and approaches the shore.

arxiv-2103-02270.title: Temporal-Structure-Assisted Gradient Aggregation for Over-the-Air Federated Edge Learning
arxiv-2103-02270.creator: Dian Fan, Xiaojun Yuan, and Ying-Jun Angela Zhang
arxiv-2103-02270.description: Abstract In this paper, we investigate over-the-air model aggregation in a federated edge learning (FEEL) system. We introduce a Markovian probability model to characterize the intrinsic temporal structure of the model aggregation series. With this temporal probability model, we formulate the model aggregation problem as to infer the desired aggregated update given all the past observations from a Bayesian perspective.

arxiv-2109-12651.title: Why Do We Click: Visual Impression-aware News Recommendation Conference: Proceedings of the 29th ACM International Conference on Multimedia; October 20–24, 2021; Virtual Event, China Proceedings of the 29th ACM International Conference on Multimedia (MM ’21), October 20–24, 2021, Virtual Event, Chin
arxiv-2109-12651.creator: Jiahao Xun 1∗ , Shengyu Zhang 1∗ , Zhou Zhao 1† , Jieming Zhu 2 , Qi Zhang 2 , Jingjie Li 2 , Xiuqiang He 2 , Xiaofei He 1 , Tat-Seng Chua 3 , Fei Wu 1
arxiv-2109-12651.description: Abstract . There is a soaring interest in the news recommendation research scenario due to the information overload. To accurately capture users’ interests, we propose to model multi-modal features, in addition to the news titles that are widely used in existing works, for news recommendation.

arxiv-2211-10815.title: Non-stationary Risk-sensitive Reinforcement Learning: Near-optimal Dynamic Regret, Adaptive Detection, and Separation Design
arxiv-2211-10815.creator: Yuhao Ding, Ming Jin, Javad Lavaei
arxiv-2211-10815.description: Abstract We study risk-sensitive reinforcement learning (RL) based on an entropic risk measure in episodic non-stationary Markov decision processes (MDPs). Both the reward functions and the state transition kernels are unknown and allowed to vary arbitrarily over time with a budget on their cumulative variations.

arxiv-2212-14399.title: Quantum Mass Production Theorems
arxiv-2212-14399.creator: William Kretschmer
arxiv-2212-14399.description: Abstract We prove that for any n n -qubit unitary transformation U U and for any r = 2 o ⁡ ( n / log ⁡ n ) r=2^{o(n/\log n)} , there exists a quantum circuit to implement U ⊗ r U^{\otimes r} with at most O ⁡ ( 4 n ) O(4^{n}) gates.

arxiv-2302-13033.title: Speaker Recognition in Realistic Scenario Using Multimodal Data PubID: pubid: 979-8-3503-2212-5/23/$31.00 ©2023 IEEE
arxiv-2302-13033.creator: Saqlain Hussain Shah, Muhammad Saad Saeed, Shah Nawaz, Muhammad Haroon Yousaf{saqlain.hussain, saad.saeed, haroon.yousaf}@uettaxila.edu.pk, shah.nawaz@desy.de
arxiv-2302-13033.description: Abstract In recent years, an association is established between faces and voices of celebrities leveraging large scale audio-visual information from YouTube. The availability of large scale audio-visual datasets is instrumental in developing speaker recognition methods based on standard Convolutional Neural Networks. Thus, the aim of this paper is to leverage large scale audio-visual information to improve speaker recognition task.

arxiv-2303-02526.title: A Three-regime Theorem for flow-firing
arxiv-2303-02526.creator: Sarah Brauner, Galen Dorpalen-Barry, Selvi Kara, Caroline Klivans, Lisa Schneider
arxiv-2303-02526.description: Abstract . Graphical chip-firing is a discrete dynamical system where chips are placed on the vertices of a graph and exchanged via simple firing moves. Recent work has sought to generalize chip-firing on graphs to higher dimensions, wherein graphs are replaced by cellular complexes and chip-firing becomes flow-rerouting along the faces of the complex.

arxiv-2303-12808.title: Paco : Provocation Involving Action, Culture, and Oppression
arxiv-2303-12808.creator: Vaibhav Garg, Ganning Xu, Munindar P. Singhvgarg3@ncsu.edu, ganningxu@gmail.com, mpsingh@ncsu.edu
arxiv-2303-12808.description: Abstract Warning: This paper may include examples that can be triggering to some readers, especially to the people of a religious group. In India, people identify with a particular group based on certain attributes such as religion. The same religious groups are often provoked against each other.

arxiv-2307-12857.title: Coincidence detection probability of ( γ , 2 ​ e ) (\gamma,2e) photoemission measurement
arxiv-2307-12857.creator: Yuehua Su, Kun Cao, Chao Zhang
arxiv-2307-12857.description: Abstract In the study of the strongly correlated electrons, one of the challenging core tasks is to develop the potential techniques for direct detection of the many-body correlations of the strongly correlated electrons. ( γ , 2 ​ e ) (\gamma,2e) photoemission technique has been developed to investigate the two-body correlations of the target correlated electrons.

arxiv-2310-04568.title: NUT Solutions in Einstein-Maxwell-scalar-Gauss-Bonnet Gravity
arxiv-2310-04568.creator: M. Butler and A. M. Ghezelbash
arxiv-2310-04568.description: Abstract In this article, we consider a class of four-dimensional Einstein-Maxwell theory which is coupled non-minimally to a scalar field and the Gauss-Bonnet invariant. We mainly use the numerical methods to find the solutions to the theory, with the NUT twist. We find explicitly the numerical solutions to all of the field equations.

arxiv-2409-08723.title: FLAMO: An Open-Source Library for Frequency-Domain Differentiable Audio Processing Thanks: The Aalto University School of Electrical Engineering funded the work of the first author.
arxiv-2409-08723.creator: Gloria Dal Santo 1 , Gian Marco De Bortoli 1 , Karolina Prawda 2 , Sebastian J. Schlecht 3 , Vesa Välimäki 1
arxiv-2409-08723.description: Abstract We present FLAMO , a Frequency-sampling Library for Audio-Module Optimization designed to implement and optimize differentiable linear time-invariant audio systems. The library is open-source and built on the frequency-sampling filter design method, allowing for the creation of differentiable modules that can be used stand-alone or within the computation graph of neural networks, simplifying the development of differentiable audio systems.

arxiv-2505-09981.title: Charged wormholes in (anti-)de Sitter spacetime
arxiv-2505-09981.creator: Hyeong-Chan Kim, Wonwoo Lee
arxiv-2505-09981.description: Abstract We present a family of charged, traversable wormhole solutions in the presence of a cosmological constant. In de Sitter spacetime, two types of wormhole throats can exist–referred to as typical and cosmological throat–located at small and large radial values, respectively.

arxiv-2506-07940.title: Gradients: When Markets Meet Fine-tuning - A Distributed Approach to Model Optimisation
arxiv-2506-07940.creator: Christopher Subia-Waud
arxiv-2506-07940.description: Abstract Foundation model fine-tuning faces a fundamental challenge: existing AutoML platforms rely on single optimisation strategies that explore only a fraction of viable hyperparameter configurations. In this white paper, We introduce Gradients, a decentralised AutoML platform that transforms hyperparameter optimisation into a competitive marketplace where independent miners compete to discover optimal configurations.

arxiv-2508-11798.title: Where does non-Universality in Assembly Bias come from?
arxiv-2508-11798.creator: Charuhas Shiveshwarkar, Marilena Loverde, Christopher M. Hirata, Drew Jamieson
arxiv-2508-11798.description: Abstract Constraints on local primordial non-Gaussianity (LPnG) obtained from galaxy power spectra are limited by the perfect degeneracy between the LPnG parameter f NL f_{\mathrm{NL}} and the bias parameter b ϕ b_{\phi} which encodes the response of galaxy clustering to a change in the amplitude of primordial curvature fluctuations.

pmc-10534036.description: BackgroundThe outbreaks of infectious diseases, such as coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19), have seriously affected the normal work and life of the public, as well as the normal diagnosis and treatment of other diseases due to their strong infectivity, high population susceptibility, and diverse clinical manifestations.

pmc-11509275.title: Investigating Non-Native Ribbon Worm Cephalothrix simula as a Potential Source of Tetrodotoxin in British Bivalve Shellfish
pmc-11509275.creator: Monika Dhanji-Rapkova, Robert G Hatfield, David I Walker, Chantelle Hooper, Sarah Alewijnse, Craig Baker-Austin, Andrew D Turner, Jennifer M Ritchie, Sandra Lage
pmc-11509275.description: Tetrodotoxin (TTX) is a potent marine neurotoxin found in several phylogenetically diverse organisms, some of which are sought as seafood. Since 2015, TTX has been reported in bivalve shellfish from several estuarine locations along the Mediterranean and European Atlantic coasts, posing an emerging food safety concern.

pmc-11645906.title: Scoping Review: The Effects of Interrupted Onabotulinumtoxin A Treatment for Chronic Migraine Prevention During the COVID-19 Pandemic
pmc-11645906.creator: Qing Zhao Ruan, Daniel J Pak, Amitabh Gulati, Moises Dominguez, Sudhir Diwan, Jamal Hasoon, Timothy R Deer, R Jason Yong, Abdulrazaq Albilali, Amanda Macone, Sait Ashina, Christopher L Robinson
pmc-11645906.description: ObjectiveTo systematically examine the literature on the clinical consequences of inadvertent delays in scheduled onabotulinumtoxin A (OTA) therapy for chronic migraine during the COVID-19 pandemic and assess recommendations when access to OTA is limited.BackgroundThe coronavirus (COVID-19) pandemic was unprecedented in its impact on the global medical community.

pmc-12569072.title: Global monthly CMIP6-downscaled high-resolution (1 km) near-surface air temperature dataset (1950–2100)
pmc-12569072.creator: Xuewen Lei, Qingyan Meng, Ming Luo, Linlin Zhang, Mijia Yin, Longfei Liu, Qikang Zhao
pmc-12569072.description: Temperature projections from general circulation models (GCMs), serving as an important approach of understanding future global warming, are essential for developing adaptation and mitigation strategies of climate change. However, the coarse spatial resolutions (~1–3°) limit their effectiveness at fine-scale (e.g., intra-urban) research. Here, we produced MoCHAT, a global monthly CMIP6-downscaled high-resolution (1 km) near-surface air temperature dataset.

pmc-13265289.title: Human umbilical cord mesenchymal stem cell–derived exosomes are associated with changes in renal injury markers, gut microbiota composition, and inflammatory signaling in IgA nephropathy
pmc-13265289.creator: Yuanyuan He, Xinyi Wang, Qian Hu, Lu Huang, Shibin Zhang, Shengzhi Zhang, Zhengxia Zhong
pmc-13265289.description: BackgroundIgA nephropathy (IgAN) is the most common primary glomerulonephritis worldwide and a leading cause of end-stage kidney disease, yet disease-specific therapeutic options remain limited. Emerging evidence implicates gut microbiota dysbiosis and innate immune activation, particularly NLRP3 (NOD-, LRR- and pyrin domain-containing protein 3) inflammasome-related signaling, in IgAN pathogenesis.

pmc-13396734.title: Excitatory paraventricular thalamus–posterior insular cortex circuit mediates pain–anxiety comorbidity in diabetic neuropathy
pmc-13396734.creator: Min Wei, Jiayin Shou, Jing Yang, Siqing Cai, Qiyuan Bai, Jinwen Hou, Ye Jiang, Shixiong Shen, Zhuoying Yu, Xinru Zhao, Yongzheng Han, Jie Cai, Xue-wei Yang, Zhengqian Li, Daqing Ma, Guo-Gang Xing, Min Li
pmc-13396734.description: Painful diabetic neuropathy (PDN) is frequently accompanied by anxiety, yet the neural circuit mechanisms associated with nociceptive hypersensitivity to affective dysfunction remain unclear. Here we combined brain-wide c-Fos mapping, viral tracing, in vivo fiber photometry, whole-cell recordings, and projection-specific opto/chemogenetics in a mouse model of streptozotocin-induced PDN to define a thalamo–cortex circuit for pain–anxiety comorbidity.

pmc-13487984.title: Associations of cumulative exposure and dynamic trajectories of the cholesterol–HDL–glucose index and its obesity-related derivatives with cardiovascular disease: a nationwide prospective cohort study
pmc-13487984.creator: Han Wang, Guirong Song, Guorong Li, Dongmei Hu, Ying Zhang, Zhuowei Sun, Chenxi Zhai, Dongyong Zhang, Xiao Tang
pmc-13487984.description: BackgroundIntegrating metabolic biomarkers with anthropometric indicators has been shown to enhance the discriminative capacity for cardiovascular disease (CVD). However, the impact of the cholesterol–HDL–glucose index (CHG) and its derivatives on CVD risk remains unclear. This study aimed to investigate the associations of CHG and its derivatives with CVD and to compare their discriminative performance.

pmc-13685113.title: Prevalence of Y93H resistance-associated substitution in treatment-naïve hepatitis C virus genotype 1b patients: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-13685113.creator: Dilip Kumar Kakru, Do-Youn Lee, Navin Kumar, Rekha Arcot, Sorabh Lakhanpal, Saumya Das, Sanjay Kumar, Sushma Narsing Katkuri, Jeffrin Reneus Paul, Abhay M. Gaidhane, Prakasini Satapathy
pmc-13685113.description: BackgroundHepatitis C virus (HCV) genotype 1b infection remains a leading cause of chronic liver disease despite advances in direct-acting antivirals (DAAs). Resistance-associated substitutions (RASs) in the non-structural 5 A (NS5A) region, particularly the Y93H mutation, have been associated with reduced antiviral susceptibility and variable treatment outcomes.
